children: Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) is accelerating its AI pivot—posting $331.8B FY revenue with Azure up 43%, an $678B commercial RPO backlog, big AI capex and data‑center deals, model partnerships and quantum‑safe moves, even as it restructures and weathers service hiccups.
Previous Week Recap
Microsoft Revenue Growth And AI Capex
: Microsoft (MSFT) Q-trly revenue $90B; FY revenue $331.8B. Azure up 43% this quarter. Company plans about $175B capex for AI infrastructure in 2026.
Commercial RPO Backlog Rise
: Microsoft (MSFT) said commercial RPO backlog rose 84% to $678B, about 7.5 quarters of current revenue — a measure of contracted future revenue and backlog at disclosure.
AI Compute Cluster Deployment
: ChronoScale and Microsoft (MSFT) will deploy a 50 MW AI compute cluster in North America using NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 servers, liquid cooling, and high-performance networking to run dense AI workloads.
Azure Talks Moonshot Kimi K3
: Microsoft (MSFT) is in early talks to host Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 on Azure, exploring a revenue-share up to 30%; negotiations on data access and token-audit terms remain unresolved.
Saudi Arabic AI Services Deal
: Microsoft (MSFT) struck a Saudi deal to deliver Arabic-focused AI services, expand cloud, deploy AI models and software in the region; timeline for Arabic AI product uptake remains uncertain.
Data Center Leasing Leaders
: Q1 2026: Microsoft (MSFT) led U.S. data center leasing activity as tech firms committed over $850B to leases; Oracle and Meta were also major spenders.
Quantum-Resistant Encryption Rollout
: Microsoft will adopt quantum-resistant encryption across products, cloud services and infrastructure by 2029, updating cryptographic algorithms and controls to prepare for quantum computing risks.
AI-Driven Restructuring And Jobs
: Bank of America says Microsoft shifted resources to AI, restructured and cut thousands of jobs as part of efficiency drive; key trading facts: AI focus, restructuring, sizable workforce reductions.
AR-Rendering AI Glasses Patents
: Microsoft (MSFT) holds 409 AR-rendering patent families for AI smart glasses, near Meta’s 445; patent filings peaked in 2017 and have slowed since — relevant for tech/IP-focused traders.
Teams Performance In APAC
: MSFT: Microsoft 365 maintenance caused degraded Microsoft Teams performance in the Asia-Pacific region, impacting user access and call quality during the incident.
